# MCP tool reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:tools` from the Zod schemas. Do not edit by hand. -->

Cutline exposes 24 tools. All times are in **seconds**. Every tool returns a one-line
summary plus compact JSON (also as `structuredContent`); errors carry a code and a hint that
says how to fix the call. `projectId` is optional everywhere: it defaults to the project you
created or used most recently.

## Server instructions

Sent to the client on connect:

```text
Cutline is a video editor. The timeline is a JSON document that a human is watching live in a browser; every change you make appears there immediately (highlighted), and they may edit too.

How to work:
- All times are in seconds. Tracks are stacked bottom (index 0) to top. Clips never overlap on one track.
- Start with get_project (or create_project), then add_asset for media and add_clip to place it.
- Ids (clip_…, track_…, asset_…) come from tool results; call get_project again when unsure, since ranges and ids change after cuts.
- To remove silences: detect_silence, then delete_range with the returned ranges (it ripples all tracks so audio, video and captions stay in sync).
- To add subtitles: add_captions with fromTranscript=true (do this AFTER cutting, so captions match the final timing).
- To check your work: get_frames (look at stills), get_waveform_summary, get_transcript.
- Finish with export_video (server-side MP4) and give the user the download URL.
- Everything is undoable (undo/redo), including the human's edits. apply_operations batches many edits into one undo step.
- Errors include a hint describing how to fix the call.
```

## Editing

### `create_project`

**Create project.** Create a new, empty video project (with tracks V1 and A1) and make it the active project. Returns the project id and the URL where the user can watch edits live.

| Parameter         | Type                   | Required | Description                        |
| ----------------- | ---------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `name`            | string                 | yes      | Project name                       |
| `width`           | integer (≥ 16, ≤ 7680) |          | Output width in px (default 1920)  |
| `height`          | integer (≥ 16, ≤ 4320) |          | Output height in px (default 1080) |
| `fps`             | number (≤ 240)         |          | Frame rate (default 30)            |
| `backgroundColor` | string                 |          | Color as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA      |

### `get_project`

**Get project.** Read the timeline: tracks (bottom to top), clips with ids, timeline start/end and source in/out (seconds), assets and settings. Call this to find clip ids before editing. Without a projectId it uses the active project and also lists the other projects.

_Annotations: readOnly_

| Parameter   | Type    | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string  |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `full`      | boolean |          | Return the complete raw JSON document instead of the compact summary   |

### `add_asset`

**Add asset.** Import a media file (video, audio or image) into the project from an absolute local path on the server machine or from an http(s) URL. Returns the asset id plus duration, size and whether it has audio/video. Importing does not put anything on the timeline: use add_clip next.

| Parameter   | Type   | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `path`      | string |          | Absolute file path on the machine running the Cutline server           |
| `url`       | string |          | http(s) URL to download                                                |
| `name`      | string |          | Display name (default: file name)                                      |

### `add_clip`

**Add clip.** Place an asset on the timeline. Defaults: appended at the end of the first suitable track, using the whole asset (images: 5s). Video assets keep their audio on the same clip. Use clipType "audio" to place only the audio of a video. Returns the new clip id.

| Parameter     | Type                                     | Required | Description                                                                                                      |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId`   | string                                   |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently.                                           |
| `assetId`     | string                                   | yes      |                                                                                                                  |
| `trackId`     | string                                   |          | Target track (default: first suitable track with room, or a new one)                                             |
| `start`       | number (≥ 0)                             |          | Timeline position in seconds (default: end of the track)                                                         |
| `sourceStart` | number (≥ 0)                             |          | In-point within the asset in seconds (default 0)                                                                 |
| `duration`    | number                                   |          | Length in seconds (default: rest of the asset)                                                                   |
| `clipType`    | `"video"` \| `"audio"` \| `"image"`      |          |                                                                                                                  |
| `mode`        | `"error"` \| `"overwrite"` \| `"insert"` |          | If the range is occupied: "error" (default), "overwrite" existing material, or "insert" (push later clips right) |
| `volume`      | number (≥ 0, ≤ 4)                        |          | Linear gain, 1 = unchanged                                                                                       |
| `transform`   | object                                   |          | Position offset from center (px), scale, rotation (deg), opacity                                                 |

### `split_clip`

**Split clip.** Cut a clip in two at a timeline time (seconds). The left part keeps the id; the right part gets a new id (returned as newClipId).

| Parameter   | Type         | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string       |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `clipId`    | string       | yes      |                                                                        |
| `time`      | number (≥ 0) | yes      | Timeline time of the cut                                               |

### `trim_clip`

**Trim clip.** Change where a clip starts and/or ends on the timeline. Moving the start also moves the source in-point (like dragging the clip edge in an editor). ripple=true shifts the following clips on the same track to keep the gap closed.

| Parameter   | Type         | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string       |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `clipId`    | string       | yes      |                                                                        |
| `start`     | number (≥ 0) |          | New timeline start                                                     |
| `end`       | number (≥ 0) |          | New timeline end                                                       |
| `ripple`    | boolean      |          |                                                                        |

### `move_clip`

**Move clip.** Move a clip to a new timeline start, optionally onto another compatible track.

| Parameter   | Type                                     | Required | Description                                                                                                      |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string                                   |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently.                                           |
| `clipId`    | string                                   | yes      |                                                                                                                  |
| `start`     | number (≥ 0)                             | yes      | Time in seconds                                                                                                  |
| `trackId`   | string                                   |          |                                                                                                                  |
| `mode`      | `"error"` \| `"overwrite"` \| `"insert"` |          | If the range is occupied: "error" (default), "overwrite" existing material, or "insert" (push later clips right) |

### `delete_clip`

**Delete clips.** Delete one or more clips. ripple=true closes the gaps on their tracks. To cut a time range out of the whole timeline (all tracks), use delete_range instead.

_Annotations: destructive_

| Parameter   | Type     | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string   |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `clipIds`   | string[] | yes      |                                                                        |
| `ripple`    | boolean  |          |                                                                        |

### `delete_range`

**Delete time ranges.** Cut timeline ranges (seconds) out of all unlocked tracks at once, splitting clips as needed, and close the gaps (ripple) so video, audio and captions stay in sync. This is the tool for removing silences, filler or mistakes: pass the ranges from detect_silence or get_transcript directly. Ranges may be given in any order and may overlap.

_Annotations: destructive_

| Parameter   | Type     | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string   |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `ranges`    | object[] | yes      | Timeline ranges to remove, in the CURRENT timeline time                |
| `trackIds`  | string[] |          | Only these tracks (default: all unlocked tracks)                       |
| `ripple`    | boolean  |          | Close the gaps (default true)                                          |

### `set_clip_property`

**Set clip properties.** Change clip properties: transform {x, y (px offset from center), scale, rotation (deg), opacity 0..1}, effects {brightness, contrast, saturation (-1..1), blur (px); null removes}, keyframes per property (clip-relative seconds; [] removes), fadeIn/fadeOut (s), volume/muted, text and style for text clips, words for captions, transitionIn. Only the fields you pass are changed.

| Parameter   | Type   | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `clipId`    | string | yes      |                                                                        |
| `props`     | object | yes      |                                                                        |

### `add_text_overlay`

**Add text overlay.** Add a text title/overlay. By default it is centered on screen on a text track above the video; use transform.y to move it (positive = down, in px at project resolution, e.g. y=400 for a lower third at 1080p).

| Parameter   | Type                                     | Required | Description                                                                                                      |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string                                   |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently.                                           |
| `text`      | string                                   | yes      |                                                                                                                  |
| `start`     | number (≥ 0)                             | yes      | Time in seconds                                                                                                  |
| `duration`  | number                                   |          | Seconds (default 3)                                                                                              |
| `trackId`   | string                                   |          |                                                                                                                  |
| `style`     | object                                   |          | fontSize (px), color, backgroundColor, bold, align, …                                                            |
| `transform` | object                                   |          |                                                                                                                  |
| `mode`      | `"error"` \| `"overwrite"` \| `"insert"` |          | If the range is occupied: "error" (default), "overwrite" existing material, or "insert" (push later clips right) |

### `add_captions`

**Add captions.** Add subtitles on a caption track. Either pass cues [{start, end, text}] in timeline seconds, or set fromTranscript=true to transcribe the current timeline audio (speech-to-text, word timings) and generate readable cues automatically — the usual choice for "add captions". Replaces existing captions on the track unless replace=false.

| Parameter        | Type                  | Required | Description                                                               |
| ---------------- | --------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId`      | string                |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently.    |
| `cues`           | object[]              |          |                                                                           |
| `fromTranscript` | boolean               |          | Generate cues from the timeline transcript                                |
| `language`       | string                |          | Spoken language for transcription, e.g. "en", "de" (default: auto-detect) |
| `maxChars`       | integer (≥ 10, ≤ 120) |          | Max characters per cue (default 42)                                       |
| `style`          | object                |          |                                                                           |
| `replace`        | boolean               |          |                                                                           |
| `trackId`        | string                |          |                                                                           |

### `add_transition`

**Add transition.** Add a transition INTO a clip from the clip right before it on the same track: "crossfade" (dissolve, centered on the cut) or "dipToBlack". Without a preceding clip it fades in from transparent. type "none" removes it. Audio follows the transition.

| Parameter   | Type                                        | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string                                      |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `clipId`    | string                                      | yes      | The clip the transition leads into                                     |
| `type`      | `"crossfade"` \| `"dipToBlack"` \| `"none"` | yes      |                                                                        |
| `duration`  | number (≤ 10)                               |          | Seconds (default 1)                                                    |

### `set_audio_volume`

**Set audio volume.** Set the volume (linear gain: 0 = silent, 1 = unchanged, 2 ≈ +6 dB), mute, or fades of a clip, or the volume/mute of a whole track. Give exactly one of clipId or trackId.

| Parameter   | Type               | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string             |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `clipId`    | string             |          |                                                                        |
| `trackId`   | string             |          |                                                                        |
| `volume`    | number (≥ 0, ≤ 4)  |          |                                                                        |
| `muted`     | boolean            |          |                                                                        |
| `fadeIn`    | number (≥ 0, ≤ 60) |          | Seconds (clips only)                                                   |
| `fadeOut`   | number (≥ 0, ≤ 60) |          | Seconds (clips only)                                                   |

### `apply_operations`

**Apply operations.** Apply a batch of low-level operations atomically as ONE undo step (all or nothing). Covers everything the editor UI can do, including tracks (add_track, update_track: name/mute/hide/lock/volume/captionStyle, remove_track, move_track), project settings (update_project), and remove_asset, plus all clip operations. Use the dedicated tools for single edits.

| Parameter    | Type     | Required | Description                                                            |
| ------------ | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId`  | string   |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `operations` | object[] | yes      |                                                                        |
| `label`      | string   |          | Name of the undo step                                                  |

### `undo`

**Undo.** Undo the most recent change to the project, whoever made it (you or the human in the editor).

| Parameter   | Type   | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |

### `redo`

**Redo.** Redo the change that was last undone (by you or by the human in the editor).

| Parameter   | Type   | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |

## Perception

### `get_transcript`

**Get transcript.** Speech-to-text of the edited timeline (default) or of one asset, with timestamps in seconds. format "segments" (default) returns sentence-like lines with start/end; "words" adds word-level timings (use them to cut precisely, e.g. remove filler words with delete_range); "text" returns plain text. Uses local Whisper; results are cached per asset.

_Annotations: readOnly_

| Parameter   | Type                                  | Required | Description                                                                                   |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string                                |          | Project id (default: active project)                                                          |
| `assetId`   | string                                |          | Analyse one source asset (source time) instead of the edited timeline (default: the timeline) |
| `language`  | string                                |          | e.g. "en", "de" (default: auto-detect)                                                        |
| `format`    | `"segments"` \| `"words"` \| `"text"` |          |                                                                                               |

### `get_frames`

**Get frames.** Look at the video: returns JPEG thumbnails of the composited timeline (all layers, text and captions) at evenly spaced times between start and end, or at explicit times. With assetId, returns frames of that source file instead.

_Annotations: readOnly_

| Parameter   | Type                   | Required | Description                                                                                   |
| ----------- | ---------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string                 |          | Project id (default: active project)                                                          |
| `assetId`   | string                 |          | Analyse one source asset (source time) instead of the edited timeline (default: the timeline) |
| `start`     | number (≥ 0)           |          | Default 0                                                                                     |
| `end`       | number (≥ 0)           |          | Default: end of timeline / asset                                                              |
| `count`     | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 24)    |          | Number of frames (default 6)                                                                  |
| `times`     | number[]               |          | Exact times instead of start/end/count                                                        |
| `width`     | integer (≥ 64, ≤ 1280) |          | Thumbnail width in px (default 320)                                                           |

### `detect_silence`

**Detect silence.** Find pauses in the edited timeline audio (default) or in one asset. Returns silent ranges in seconds, already shrunk by `padding` so cuts keep a natural breath. To remove them, pass `ranges` straight to delete_range. Tune thresholdDb (-50 = only near-digital silence, -30 = also quiet room noise).

_Annotations: readOnly_

| Parameter     | Type                  | Required | Description                                                                                   |
| ------------- | --------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId`   | string                |          | Project id (default: active project)                                                          |
| `assetId`     | string                |          | Analyse one source asset (source time) instead of the edited timeline (default: the timeline) |
| `thresholdDb` | number (≥ -90, ≤ -10) |          | RMS level counted as silence (default -40 dBFS)                                               |
| `minDuration` | number (≥ 0.05, ≤ 60) |          | Ignore shorter pauses (default 0.5s)                                                          |
| `padding`     | number (≥ 0, ≤ 2)     |          | Audio kept on each side (default 0.15s)                                                       |

### `detect_scenes`

**Detect scenes.** Find shot changes (visual cuts) in the timeline video (default) or in one asset. Returns cut times in seconds; for the timeline, also the clip boundaries (edits that already exist).

_Annotations: readOnly_

| Parameter   | Type                   | Required | Description                                                                                   |
| ----------- | ---------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string                 |          | Project id (default: active project)                                                          |
| `assetId`   | string                 |          | Analyse one source asset (source time) instead of the edited timeline (default: the timeline) |
| `threshold` | number (≥ 0.05, ≤ 0.9) |          | Scene change sensitivity, lower = more cuts (default 0.3)                                     |

### `get_waveform_summary`

**Get waveform summary.** Loudness overview of the timeline audio (default) or one asset: overall peak/RMS in dBFS and per-bucket levels, plus the loudest and quietest parts. Useful to spot music, speech, silence or clipping without listening.

_Annotations: readOnly_

| Parameter   | Type                 | Required | Description                                                                                   |
| ----------- | -------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string               |          | Project id (default: active project)                                                          |
| `assetId`   | string               |          | Analyse one source asset (source time) instead of the edited timeline (default: the timeline) |
| `buckets`   | integer (≥ 4, ≤ 200) |          | Number of time buckets (default 40)                                                           |

## Output

### `render_preview`

**Render preview.** Quickly render a low-resolution MP4 of the timeline (or a range) to check timing and sound. Returns a URL the user can open and the file path. Use get_frames to look at stills yourself.

_Annotations: readOnly_

| Parameter   | Type                    | Required | Description                          |
| ----------- | ----------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `projectId` | string                  |          | Project id (default: active project) |
| `start`     | number (≥ 0)            |          | Time in seconds                      |
| `end`       | number (≥ 0)            |          | Time in seconds                      |
| `width`     | integer (≥ 160, ≤ 1280) |          | Default 640                          |

### `export_video`

**Export video.** Render the final MP4 (H.264/AAC) on the server with ffmpeg. Returns a download URL and the file path. Quality: "draft" (fast), "standard" (default), "high" (slow, best). The user can also export in the browser from the Export dialog.

| Parameter   | Type                                  | Required | Description                              |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string                                |          | Project id (default: active project)     |
| `quality`   | `"draft"` \| `"standard"` \| `"high"` |          |                                          |
| `width`     | integer (≥ 160, ≤ 7680)               |          | Default: project width                   |
| `fps`       | number (≤ 120)                        |          | Default: project fps                     |
| `start`     | number (≥ 0)                          |          | Time in seconds                          |
| `end`       | number (≥ 0)                          |          | Time in seconds                          |
| `fileName`  | string                                |          | File name prefix (default: project name) |
